The template check (no AI) looks for the five headings; if present, the file becomes `intent.md` unchanged and the spec step starts. Otherwise the intake agent drafts the template from the user's words, asks at most 5 questions, takes answers through the engine, labels inferences "Assumption:", and writes `intake.json` (questions, answers, model, usage). A deterministic check rejects a draft whose Problem or Proposed outcome contains content words not found in the request or answers (with a small allow-list of function words), and the agent is rerun once. The `intent` gate applies only to agent-written intents; the engine records time to intent and whether the draft was approved unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.text: `request.md` is byte-identical to the input, including a Hindi UTF-8 sample and CRLF line endings (`tests/intake/test_request.py`).
A file with all five headings becomes `intent.md` unchanged and skips the intake agent and the `intent` gate; one missing heading goes to the intake agent.
A fake intake output with 6 questions is truncated to 5 and the event records it; answers are passed back on the next call.
The user-words check rejects a Problem containing a phrase absent from the request and answers, and accepts one that reuses them.
Approving the draft unchanged records `survived_unchanged=true` and the time to intent; an edited draft records `false`.
[owner] With the real intake agent, 2–3 Hindi or Hindi–English requests produce English intents that quote the original lines (spec §19.7); results noted in the task's test report.

tasks.title: Intake scout and `research.md`
tasks.description: Spec §7.1 "Intake scout", D23, §19.14. When `intake_research = "local"`, the scout runs before the intake agent with read-only Read, Grep and Glob over the target repo and `sdlc/requirements/*/{intent,spec}.md`, no shell, web or MCP tools, within the configured tool-call and token limits, on Haiku 5.5 medium. It writes `research.md` with facts only, each citing a path, line or requirement id, in four sections (touched modules, what exists, possible duplicates, unanswered questions). A deterministic check drops uncited facts and lines that propose solutions. On limit or failure, intake continues without research and the event log records it. The intake agent uses research only for sharper questions, "From codebase: … (source)" lines and a "Possible duplicate of R-…" line, and the `intent` gate shows request, draft and research side by side with research-sourced lines strikable.

acceptance_criteria.text: The scout's allowed tools are exactly Read, Grep and Glob, and its path filter allows only the repo and `sdlc/requirements/*/{intent,spec}.md` (`tests/intake/test_scout.py`).

The proposal check flags lines such as "We should add…" or "Implement…" and removes them, with an event.
A scout call that hits its tool-call limit ends, intake proceeds, and an `intake.research_skipped` event names the reason.
With `intake_research = "off"` (and always in evaluation runs) no scout call is made.
